fields.name: register_id
fields.hint: the rights register file identifier, verbatim

fields.name: property_title
fields.hint: the title of the optioned property ONLY -- the text inside the quotation marks, verbatim and without the quotation marks themselves. The register writes the form of the work after a double dash (for example: "A Title" -- stage play); the form is NOT part of the title and must not be returned

fields.name: rights_holder
fields.hint: the party that granted the option -- the GRANTOR OF RECORD, verbatim. This is the party a notice has to be served on for a notice-controlled extension to be perfected

fields.name: grantee
fields.hint: the party holding the option, verbatim

fields.name: register_as_of
fields.hint: the date this register snapshot is current as at, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). This is the 'today' the whole count is measured against -- it is NOT today's real date

fields.name: option_granted_date
fields.hint: the date the option was granted, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Where the Option Granted section states exactly ONE date, return it -- always, whatever the Clock Basis says. ⚠︎ ONLY where the section carries TWO dated entries that DISAGREE about the same grant, return null: the register does not settle it, and you must not pick the earlier one, the later one, or the one from the more official-looking source

fields.name: clock_basis
fields.hint: what the agreement says starts the option clock, as the register's Clock Basis section states it

fields.name: trigger_status
fields.hint: whether the triggering event has happened. 'not_applicable' when the clock runs from the grant date and there is no triggering event at all

fields.name: trigger_date
fields.hint: the date the triggering event actually occurred, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). null when there is no triggering event, or when there is one and it has not occurred

fields.name: initial_term_months
fields.hint: the length of the initial option period in whole months, as a number

fields.name: extension_months_each
fields.hint: the length in whole months of each extension the agreement grants, as a number. Every extension in a chain is the same length in this register's format

fields.name: extensions_recorded_taken
fields.hint: how many extensions the register RECORDS as exercised -- count the extension entries whose 'recorded:' line says exercised. This is what the file claims; it is NOT what decides the expiry

fields.name: extensions_perfected
fields.hint: how many of those extensions were actually PERFECTED under the rulebook -- a payment-controlled extension needs BOTH a payment reference and a payment date recorded against it; a notice-controlled extension needs notice served on the rights holder named on this register, and service on an agent, a co-financier, an escrow party or the grantee's own counsel does not count. An extension recorded as exercised whose act is missing or misdirected is NOT perfected

fields.name: register_status
fields.hint: the status the register itself carries in its Register Status section, copied verbatim. Report it as stated -- it is NOT what decides the answer

fields.name: clerk_note
fields.hint: the rights clerk's own free-text remark on the file, copied verbatim

fields.name: expiry_date
fields.hint: the date the option expires, counted under the rulebook: the clock start, plus the initial term, plus the length of each PERFECTED extension, in calendar months. Return null when no expiry can be counted. This date is nowhere on the register -- it is the count

fields.name: status
fields.hint: the option's status against the register's own as-of date, from the counted expiry. 'lapsed' when the expiry is on or before the as-of date; 'lapsing' when it is after the as-of date and on or before as-of plus the window the rulebook names; 'live' when it is beyond that; 'not_determinable' when no expiry can be counted -- a triggering event that has not occurred, or two entries disagreeing about a grant date the clock runs from. Decide it STRICTLY from the count -- never from register_status and never from clerk_note
